name: Wrecknest Passage
introDiscord:
Seven wrecks have been compressed into one tangled structure between
the bones.

Wrecknest Morays have decided this is excellent housing.
introTwitch:
Seven wrecks have been compressed into one tangled structure between
the bones.

Wrecknest Morays have decided this is excellent housing.

wrecknest-passage-approach.prompt: Three passages enter the fused wreckage.

left.message:
One Berry rests inside an old captain's drawer.

Shizuki wrote:

'Ship #1 connected to Ship #2 connected to Ship #3.

Stopped counting.

Calling entire thing Ship.'

right.message: A navigator's chest survives inside the fused hull.

forward.message:
A Wrecknest Moray emerges through three different ship windows before
choosing yours.

wrecknest-passage-depths.prompt: Three corridors weave through overlapping decks.

left.message:
A Moray slips through a cannon port from one ship into another.

Extremely convenient architecture if you're an eel.

right.message:
Shizuki's medicine rests inside an intact cabin:

'Best room in Ship.

Door closes.

Mostly dry-ish.

Moray lives in closet.

Deducting star.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the medicine and definitely do not inspect the closet.

forward.message: A strongbox lies beneath two intersecting keels.

wrecknest-passage-threshold.prompt: Crushed Fleet Nest forms where all the wrecks collapse together.

left.message:
Star Candies are trapped beneath a Leviathan scale that somehow joined
the pile.

right.message: A Wrecknest Moray lunges from what used to be three doors simultaneously.

forward.message:
Shizuki's bottle reads:

'Ship rating updated:

two stars.

Closet incident.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the medicine.

No closet details are provided.

bossPromptDiscord:
The fused wreck creaks.

Something enormous moves through the entire structure without ever
leaving it.

Use /yes to enter Crushed Fleet Nest or /no to let the world's largest
eel apartment remain occupied.
bossPromptTwitch:
The fused wreck creaks.

Something enormous moves through the entire structure without ever
leaving it.

Use !yes to enter Crushed Fleet Nest or !no to let the world's largest
eel apartment remain occupied.

boss.revealText:
An enormous Moray tears through the overlapping keels.

Keeljaw Moray reveals itself!

completionText:
The Keeljaw disappears back into the wrecknest.

Ship survives.

Barely.
